expects.rule: Show the full order cost early: Baymard finds 67% of sites show no total order cost estimate near the buy section, and 40% of shoppers who left a cart blamed extra costs (shipping, tax, fees).
Do not force account creation: 18% of shoppers who abandoned a cart gave forced account creation as the reason; let guests check out and save items.
Offer size and variant options as visible buttons, not drop-downs (57% of benchmarked sites do not).
Show wearable products on a human model and add at least one image with a size reference: 42% of users judge size from images, yet 37% of sites give no in-scale image and 23% no model image.
Link or summarise the return policy on the product page and the footer: 60% of users look for it there, 44% of sites do not show it, and 15% of shoppers abandoned over an unsatisfactory policy.
Keep checkout short and trustworthy: 17% abandon over a long or complicated checkout, 19% over distrust of the site with card details, 17% over errors or crashes, 9% over too few payment methods.
Show price, availability and a visible cart count in the header without scrolling; the add-to-cart control must be reachable on a phone with one thumb.
Product lists show a real product photo, name and price per card, with working filters and a visible result count.

traits: 4 of 7 fill the first screen with one photograph or video (Theobroma, Estudio Niksen, Second Ride, Flux Theory); Lajoya and Morpho use a flat or dark ground with a 3D or tilted product.
A product is visible on the first screen of 5 of 7 (Theobroma, Niksen, Lajoya, Morpho, Second Ride's vehicles); Flux Theory shows a mood image and IGIN a game.
A cart icon or counter is in the header of 4 of 7 (Theobroma, Niksen with a count, Lajoya, Flux Theory); Morpho uses a Shop button instead.
4 of 7 have a consent box or age gate over the first screen (Niksen, Second Ride, Morpho, IGIN).
The first-screen headline is under 10 words on 6 of 7; 4 set it in a heavy or condensed display face (Theobroma, IGIN, Flux Theory, Lajoya's serif wordmark).
2 of 7 use one typeface (Niksen, Second Ride); 4 use two or three; IGIN uses four.
A language toggle is visible in the header of 4 of 7 (Theobroma FR, Niksen EN, Lajoya Es/En/Fr, Morpho EN/ES).
Page colour is a flat brand tone on 3 of 7 (cream #fff4e3, green #00ef84, navy #101820); the product or photograph supplies the rest.

sites.name: Theobroma
sites.why: Cream (#fff4e3) page; rounded dark-brown header (logo, Shop, About, Wholesale, FAQ, FR, account, search, Cart), full-width photo of chocolate bars and raspberries, heavy 'Pause mode: on Flavour: loud' headline, a 'This just in' product card with a green Discover button. Bowlby One SC, Figtree.

sites.name: Estudio Niksen
sites.why: White page: line 'All prices include duties and taxes', nav left, script logo centre, Search, EN and Cart - 0 right; full-width photo of a jacket on a fence, 'Fall Winter 26' and one Shop all new arrivals button, a consent box. PP Neue Montreal only. Bestseller labels lower.

sites.name: Second Ride
sites.why: First screen is a two-way split of photographs (rider on a moped, rider on a motorbike) with the wordmark in the middle and a label under each choice (Conversion Kits on the right); a consent box covers the left half. Nunito Sans. Header offers E-Mopeds, Conversion Kits and Book test ride.

sites.name: Lajoya
sites.why: Flat green (#00ef84) screen: oversized nav (Contact, About, Shop, Es/En/Fr, cart icon), a giant black serif wordmark stacked over two tilted tins, a HORECA / Restaurant access pill. Three typefaces (Ambiant Light Sans, JoyaMaison, Maison Neue). Product rows with euro prices lower.

sites.name: Morpho Water
sites.why: Dark navy (#101820) page with a 3D silver can in the centre, a white 'A world within.' headline in Gotham, an italic serif 'Pure possibility.', nav pill, EN/ES, a pale blue (#d0edff) Shop MORPHO button, Play and Sound controls and a consent box over the lower left. Seven numbered sections.

sites.name: IGIN USA
sites.why: White first screen taken by a game and a gate: black condensed 'Doodle Pop' headline (Anton), italic serif copy with red (#ed302a) words, a giveaway box, a 21+ Yes/No choice and a greyed Play Now, on a background of faint doodles. Inter, Archivo and a mono. No product or shop link at first sight.

sites.name: Flux Theory
sites.why: Full-screen video of a steamed shower glass with water drops, headline in condensed capitals (Oswald) bottom left over it, a translucent box top right with Shop All, About Us, account and bag icons, and an Explore Products pill. Geist for small text. A bag drawer states 'Your bag is empty'.

avoid: A newsletter or sign-up panel that covers the first screen before the shopper has seen a product.
Size or variant choice hidden in a drop-down; shipping and tax revealed only at the last checkout step.
Return policy reachable only from a legal page or the footer.
Product cards without price, or with identical stock photos and generic names.
Autoplay carousels of promotions with auto-advancing slides and no pause control.
Fake urgency (countdowns, 'only 2 left') with no stock data behind it.
